retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast side profile portrait emerging from a deep black void with a multi-layered typographic stack in the negative space.
triggerTerms: side profile portrait on black background
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are needed
modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, side-profile photograph of a male subject positioned on the left, looking toward the right. The subject is lit with warm, directional light that emphasizes skin texture and hair detail, while the entire right half of the frame is a solid black negative space containing a vertically stacked typographic block with varying styles.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze leading into the typographic block
High contrast between the warm skin tones and the absolute black background
Juxtaposition of formal photography with playful, psychedelic-influenced display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left 60% of the frame, cropped at the shoulder and top of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and the bridge of the nose serve as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, follows the gaze to the right, and descends through the stacked text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black negative space on the right side to house the information.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm flesh tones and grey hair (Subject)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between subject and background; moderate saturation in the accent typography.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name in thin, wide geometric sans-serif
Title in heavy, interlocking psychedelic script with rounded terminals
Secondary text in small, clean sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking 'oo' and 'tt' in the script title
Exaggerated swashes on the capital letters of the title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a clinical, thin sans-serif and a heavy, decorative script.

preserve: The high-contrast lighting of the portrait

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, thin uppercase name style
Provides the heavy, retro feel for the title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up side profile portrait of a man with salt-and-pepper hair, lit from the side to emphasize texture, against a pure black background. The man should be on the left side of the frame looking right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a right-aligned text block in the black space. Top lines in thin white geometric sans-serif. Middle lines in a heavy, colorful 1960s-style script. Bottom lines in a small, white sans-serif list.

verificationChecks: Is the subject in a clear side profile?
Is the text right-aligned and stacked?
Does the title text use a heavy, rounded script?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's gaze leads toward the text.
Check that the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Verify the black background is seamless and noise-free.
Confirm the script font has a 'hand-drawn' vintage quality.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait(SideProfile, LeftAligned) + Background(SolidBlack) + Typography(RightAligned, Stacked, MixedStyles)
